classification_basis: each drift item classified by reading the code at its location; code is the working/intentional reality in all cases (no ALIGN)

proposals.title: Batch cold-promotion per-thread queue depth (US-11 -> 128)
proposals.before: US-11 narrative: 'Each thread uses a reduced NVMe pipeline depth (16 / num_queues) to share the drive's submission queue capacity without overflow.' Scenario 3: '...each processed by a separate thread with max_queue_depth = 8 (16/2), keeping total per-drive NVMe commands at <=16.'
proposals.after: US-11 narrative: 'Each thread drives its cold promotions with a deep per-thread NVMe pipeline depth (max_queue_depth = 128, per FR-039 step (5) and FR-019) to saturate the drive's submission queue for maximum per-drive parallelism.' Scenario 3: '...each processed by a separate thread, and each thread drives its cold promotions with max_queue_depth = 128 (per FR-039 step (5) / FR-019) to saturate the drive's NVMe submission queue.'
proposals.rationale: batch_lookup sets `let queue_depth = 128;` (lib.rs:2217) into pipelined_multi_object_zero_copy; deliberate and already stated by FR-039 step (5) and FR-019. The US-11 story text carried the older 16/num_queues wording, an intra-spec contradiction against the aligned FRs and the code. Spec-lag -> BACKFILL the story text.

proposals.title: Dependency-injection / test hooks
proposals.before: No requirement. FR-043 covers the PipelineMetrics trait but not the injection setters; the block-device/extent-manager factory setters are entirely unspecced.
proposals.after: Add FR-057 documenting the three inherent DispatcherComponent DI setters (set_block_device_factory(BlockDeviceFactory), set_extent_manager_factory(ExtentManagerFactory), set_pipeline_metrics(Arc<dyn PipelineMetrics>)) as the test/DI surface overriding internally-constructed dependencies, with fallback to the default hard-coded implementations when unset. Add SC-016 as the measurable outcome.
proposals.rationale: Public inherent methods that ship and are used for hardware-free component testing; inherent on the concrete component, not IDispatcher trait methods (consistent with how FR-001 documents create_eviction_channel/eviction_dropped_count). Code is authoritative -> backfill a test/DI-surface requirement.
